seed: Assume positions live on a lattice. Infer the step size and bounds from the data and write movement as lattice moves with explicit bound and obstacle checks.

synth.notes:
Player 5x5 moves on a 5-cell lattice per arrow; dest blocked if off-board or any wall (4) / void (5) cell.
Conveyor: 5-cell colour-1 strip just outside a dest edge slides the player until blocked.
step_bar burns 2 leftmost cells (11->3) per arrow incl. blocked moves; covering a ring refills it.
Covering the collect diamond rotates the HUD glyph 90 CW; object restored when uncovered (continuity-gated memory).
Unconfirmed: chamber reject while glyph != legend; recolor token -> colour 9.
